verdict.rationale: LocalAI's getting-started docs state that it automatically detects the system's GPU (NVIDIA, AMD, Intel) and downloads the matching backend. That directly covers running models with vendor-specific acceleration across GPU vendors. The 'No GPU required' and CPU-first statements describe an additional CPU path and do not contradict GPU support. Missing for 10: names of the specific acceleration kernels or backends per vendor (e.g. CUDA, ROCm, SYCL), docs on manual vendor or backend selection for power users, and independent or hands-on confirmation that GPU acceleration works.
